markets.title: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the December 2026 meeting?
markets.edge: Post-Oct hold (Warsh chair, 10-2 with Cook/Hammack hike dissent) the Dec book flipped: hike25 70.5¢ / hold 26.5¢ / cut25 0.55¢. Event vol24 ~$2.02M. Modal is now hike — alpha is hold wing + calibration vs 'more data' rhetoric, not chasing the 70¢ favorite cold.
markets.trap: Resolves on upper bound of fed funds target vs pre-meeting level. Non-listed move sizes round UP to nearest 25bps bracket. Meeting calendar Dec 8–9 2026.
markets.note: Oct hold market closed Yes=1. Curve is hawkish; size on hold/hike50 wings not the modal hike.
markets.resolutionMethod: FOMC December 2026 statement: +25bps on upper bound of fed funds target

markets.title: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be the next Prime Minister of Israel?
markets.edge: Material reprice vs 10/26 26¢ → 42.5¢ after Oct27 vote. Full count: Likud largest (~27), Bibi bloc ~53 / Eizenkot ~48 / Arab ~19 — neither hits 61. Likud most-seats ~99.4¢ already dead; PM is coalition + sworn-in, not seats.
markets.trap: MUST be formally sworn in; interim/caretaker does NOT count. Other if no sworn PM by 2027-12-31 ET. Market endDate 2026-10-28 is election-adjacent — NOT sworn-in date.
markets.note: Relative: Eizenkot PM 30.5¢. Gap is coalition math + personal vetoes. Don't treat as election-night binary.
markets.resolutionMethod: Next individual officially appointed and sworn in as PM of Israel after 2026 Knesset election

markets.title: Will the Democratic Party control the House after the 2026 Midterm elections?
markets.edge: House Dem 92.5¢ / GOP 7.5¢ with event vol24 ~$4.92M and deep liq. Near-lock pricing; use as inventory/hedge leg vs Senate swing, not as alpha source.
markets.trap: Control = majority of voting seats; independents/caucus can delay attribution into Jan seating.
markets.note: Pairs with BoP D/D 67.5¢ and Senate Dem 68.5¢ — Senate is the real swing.
markets.resolutionMethod: Party winning majority of House voting seats after 2026 midterms

markets.title: 2026 Balance of Power: D Senate, D House
markets.edge: D/D 67.5¢ (vs 10/26 64.5¢); R/D 26.5¢; R/R 6.5¢. Event vol24 ~$2.60M, liq ~$18.8M. Soft +3¢ since prior scan; House lock + Senate Dem 68.5¢ supports modal D/D.
markets.trap: Senate control includes VP tiebreak path; House majority of voting seats. Other near dust.
markets.note: Better RV via Senate/Texas legs than BoP Other. Texas Dem Senate 69.5¢ is a key Senate-path input.
markets.resolutionMethod: Party control of Senate and House after 2026 midterms per official seat counts

markets.title: US x Iran ceasefire continues through October 31?
markets.edge: Yes 85.1¢ (vs 10/26 81.5¢) despite overnight Qeshm/Jask strike OSINT. Curve: Oct31 85.1 / Nov15 48.5 / Nov30 36.5 / Dec31 24.5. Market is pricing confirmation risk, not X fog — rules need US air/missile IMPACT + source consensus.
markets.trap: No on qualifying US air or surface-to-surface missile strike impacting Iran by 23:59 Iran time. Intercepted munitions / SAM / cyber / naval gunfire / minor FPV do NOT count. Thin liq (~$24k) vs vol24 ~$770k.
markets.note: If CENTCOM/credible outlets confirm impact strike before Oct31 IRST, Yes dies fast. Until then, OSINT alone is noise. Pair vs invade Yes 18.5¢.
markets.resolutionMethod: No qualifying US military strike impacting Iran by 2026-10-31 23:59 Iran Standard Time

markets.title: Will the U.S. invade Iran before 2027?
markets.edge: 18.5¢ (vs 10/26 19.5¢). Post-midterm strike-planning chatter on X ≠ invade. Rules need offensive intended to establish control over any portion of Iran — air/missile strikes alone fail. Sell-the-headline vs ceasefire-strike markets.
markets.trap: Ambiguous 'establish control' + credible-consensus resolver. Deadline Dec 31 2026 23:59 ET.
markets.note: Ceasefire Oct31 Yes 85¢ implies low confirmed-strike odds into weekend; invade Yes at 18.5¢ is still fat vs that bar if traders confuse strike with invade.
markets.resolutionMethod: US begins offensive intended to establish control over any portion of Iran by 2026-12-31 23:59 ET

markets.title: Will Gadi Eizenkot be the next Prime Minister of Israel?
markets.edge: 30.5¢ with deadlock structure (53/48/19). If Bibi cannot clear 61 without forbidden partners, opposition path + Arab kingmakers is the real underdog — not Bennett (5.05¢).
markets.trap: Same sworn-in rule; caretaker Bibi continuing does not pay this contract. Long coalition clock → Other risk into 2027-12-31.
markets.note: Neg-risk multi: Bibi+Eizenkot+others should stay ≤1. Prefer this over dust names for coalition-break thesis.
markets.resolutionMethod: Gadi Eizenkot officially appointed and sworn in as next PM after 2026 election

markets.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the December 2026 meeting?
markets.edge: Hold wing 26.5¢ after hawkish Oct hold + two hike dissents. If Warsh 'more data' + midterm fiscal fog delays, hold is the liquid lottery vs 70.5¢ hike favorite. Sum check: hold+hike25+hike50+cut25+cut50 ≈ 1.00.
markets.trap: Upper-bound definition; weird printed moves round up into 25bp brackets.
markets.note: Not a conviction hold call — it's the mispriced wing if December data softens. Size small vs modal hike.
markets.resolutionMethod: FOMC December 2026: no change on upper bound of fed funds target
